answer_1.quote: Based on the generated unspecified queries, we propose an automated method to construct training dialogue data that simulate multi-turn clarification.
answer_1.outputs: clarification dialogues and tool invocation solutions

answer_2.quote: We design four metrics to assess the quality of intent clarification. For intent clarification quality, we design four metrics. ... For tool invocation accuracy, we introduce three complementary metrics.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 3 participants, each asked to propose 10 unspecified tool-use queries requiring clarification. These queries were independently tested on the base model ... and our models.
answer_4.guideline: Participants interacted with the models iteratively until they obtained a satisfactory response, and metrics such as Task Completion Rate, Intent Coverage Rate, Interaction Rounds, and user satisfaction were recorded.
